newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKANS REWRITE RECORD BOOKS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKANS REWRITE RECORD BOOKS.

text.p: Sri Lankan second wicket pair Sanath Jayasuriya and Roshan Mahanama rewrote the record books on Tuesday as they took their world record for any wicket in test cricket to 544 against India.

After wiping out Don Bradman and Bill Ponsford's second wicket record of 451 for Australia against England in 1934, they went on to beat the previous best for any wicket of 467 scored by New Zealanders Andrew Jones and Martin Crowe against Sri Lanka in Wellington in 1991.
Jayasuriya also became the highest individual scorer for Sri Lanka when he passed the 267 which Aravinda de Silva made in the same test that Jones and Crowe set their record.
He went on to complete only the 14th triple-century in test cricket and shortly before the close he was 323 not out. Mahanama also reached his first double century in tests.
Scores: India 537-8 dec; Sri Lanka 583-1 (Sanath Jayasuriya 323 not out, Roshan Mahanama 209 not out).
